services.desc: From your first demo flight to a career as a CFI - we have the aircraft, the instructors, and the programs to get you airborne. Vineyard tours, aerial photography, VIP transport, and commercial operations - every flight is an extraordinary experience. From the nimble R-22 to the turbine-powered R-66 and iconic MD-500C - our diverse fleet supports every stage of training. Looking for an unforgettable experience? Join us for a customized wine tour around the Willamette Valley - in the heart of Oregon’s beautiful wine

quotes.text: I bought my husband a lesson for his birthday. He has always wanted to fly and I was thrilled to give him this experience. The instructor was amazing — my husband thought he was great and would definitely go back for another lesson. Scheduling was easy, super easy to find, and a reasonable price. They even have two helicopters of different sizes at different price ranges.

I took a demo flight with Kolton and a follow-on scenic flight! If you like an adventure with great value, this should be on your bucket list. Jerry Trimble Helicopters made it possible with easy scheduling and great value, and Kolton was a great flight instructor with plenty of patience.

A great flight school! Jerry Trimble is a family business that’s professionally run and has great instructors. Their scheduling system is top-notch and really appreciated. Flexible hours and good equipment. I highly recommend taking a test flight — it’ll change your life.
We went to Jerry Trimble Helicopters for a scenic flight and had a terrific time. The pilot was very professional and knowledgeable about the area. Everyone enjoyed the flight. I highly recommend it!
